section.content: 本申请属于电池技术领域，尤其涉及一种锂离子电池，包括壳体、电芯和盖板装置，盖板装置包括基板、负极组件、正极组件和密封组件，正极组件设于基板，基板开设电极通孔，负极组件包括穿过电极通孔并固定于基板的下方的负极柱，密封组件包括第一金属环、金属化陶瓷环和金属封盖，第一金属环焊于电极通孔边缘，金属化陶瓷环设于第一金属环，金属封盖设于金属化陶瓷环，金属化陶瓷环、第一金属环和金属封盖围设形成密封空间，负极柱部分容置于密封空间。这样简化了密封组件的结构设计复杂度，设置于基板上方的金属化陶瓷环、第一金属环和金属封盖不会占用电芯的装配空间，进而提供了更多装配空间，有利于改善锂离子电池的整体性能。

The utility model belongs to the technical field of the battery, especially, relate to a lithium ion battery, which comprises a housin, electric core and apron device, the apron device includes the base plate, the negative pole subassembly, positive pole subassembly and seal assembly, the base plate is located to positive pole subassembly, the electrode through-hole is seted up to the base plate, the negative pole subassembly is including passing the electrode through-hole and being fixed in the negative pole post of the below of base plate, seal assembly includes first becket, metallized ceramic ring and metal closing cap, first becket welds in electrode through-hole edge, first becket is located to metallized ceramic ring, metallized ceramic ring is located to the metal closing cap, metallized ceramic ring, first becket and metal closing cap enclose to establish and form sealed space, negative pole post part holding is in sealed space. The structural design complexity of the sealing assembly is simplified, the metalized ceramic ring, the first metal ring and the metal sealing cover which are arranged above the substrate cannot occupy the assembly space of the battery cell, so that more assembly spaces are provided, and the overall performance of the lithium ion battery is improved.

Lithium ion batteryTechnical Field

The application belongs to the technical field of batteries, and particularly relates to a lithium ion battery.

Background

In recent years, with the progress of technology, lithium ion batteries have been widely used and studied in new energy vehicles and digital products. The lithium ion battery generally has a cover plate device, and a position of the negative electrode extending out of the cover plate device is covered with a sealing article to prevent the battery cell in the battery from contacting with the outside air.

Among the prior art, for reaching good sealed effect, sealed article all can design comparatively complicatedly usually, and all set up in apron towards one side of electric core usually, so can lead to the whole manufacturing cost of lithium ion battery to be high on the one hand, and on the other hand can occupy the assembly space of electric core again, leads to the lithium ion battery performance to receive the influence.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

An object of the embodiment of the present application is to provide a lithium ion battery, which aims to solve the technical problems of complicated design and space occupation of a sealing object in the battery in the prior art.

In order to achieve the above purpose, the embodiment of the present application adopts the following technical solutions: a lithium ion battery comprises a shell, an electric core and a cover plate device, wherein the electric core and the cover plate device are arranged in the shell, the cover plate device comprises a base plate, a negative electrode component, a positive electrode component and a sealing component, the base plate is arranged above the electric core, the positive electrode component is arranged on the base plate, an electrode through hole is formed in the base plate, the negative electrode component comprises a negative electrode column, the lower end of the negative electrode column penetrates through the electrode through hole and is fixed below the base plate, the sealing component comprises a first metal ring, a metalized ceramic ring and a metal sealing cover, the first metal ring is welded on the upper side hole edge of the electrode through hole, the metalized ceramic ring is arranged on the first metal ring in a sealing manner, the metal sealing cover is arranged on the metalized ceramic ring, so that the inner wall of the metalized ceramic ring, the inner wall of the first metal ring and the metal sealing cover enclose to form a sealing space, the part of the negative pole column extending out of the electrode through hole is accommodated in the sealed space.

Optionally, the seal assembly further comprises a second metal ring sealingly connected between the metallized ceramic ring and the metal cover.

Optionally, the upper end face of the negative pole column and the upper end face of the second metal ring are welded to the lower cover face of the metal cover.

Optionally, metal layers are formed on both the upper end surface and the lower end surface of the metalized ceramic ring, and the upper end surface of the first metal ring and the lower end surface of the second metal ring are respectively welded to the two metal layers.

Optionally, the metal layer is a nickel metal layer, a molybdenum metal layer, or a manganese metal layer.

Optionally, the negative pole subassembly still includes the negative pole glue film, the negative pole glue film set up in the lower terminal surface of base plate, the cavity has been seted up to the lower terminal surface of negative pole glue film, the negative pole subassembly still includes the sheetmetal, the lower extreme of negative pole post set up in on the sheetmetal, the sheetmetal inlays to be located in the cavity, the interior top surface of cavity is seted up and is used for supplying the opening that the negative pole post passed.

Optionally, the positive pole subassembly includes anodal post, anodal glue film and anodal base, the anodal post weld in the up end of base plate, anodal glue film set up in the lower terminal surface of base plate, anodal glue film has been seted up the installation and has been led to the chamber, anodal base set up in the intracavity is led to in the installation.

Optionally, the substrate is provided with a liquid injection through hole.

Optionally, an explosion-proof through hole is formed in the substrate, the cover plate device further comprises an explosion-proof sheet, the outer edge of the explosion-proof sheet is welded to the hole edge of the explosion-proof through hole, and an explosion-proof film covers the explosion-proof sheet.

Optionally, the substrate is an aluminum substrate.

The embodiment of the application has at least the following beneficial effects: in the lithium ion battery provided by the embodiment of the application, the first metal ring of the sealing assembly is welded on the edge of the upper side hole of the electrode through hole, the metalized ceramic ring is hermetically arranged on the first metal ring, and the metal sealing cover is arranged on the metalized ceramic ring in a covering manner, so that the inner wall of the metalized ceramic ring, the inner wall of the first metal ring and the metal sealing cover surround and form a sealed space above the substrate, the part of the negative pole extending out of the electrode through hole is accommodated in the sealed space and connected with the metal sealing cover, and the sealing treatment of the negative pole is realized through the simple combination of the metalized ceramic ring, the first metal ring and the metal sealing cover, so that the structural design complexity of the sealing assembly is simplified, and the metalized ceramic ring, the first metal ring and the metal sealing cover arranged above the substrate do not occupy the assembly space of the battery cell below the substrate, and further more assembly space is provided for the battery cell, so that the overall performance of the lithium ion battery is improved.

Detailed Description

Reference will now be made in detail to embodiments of the present application, examples of which are illustrated in the accompanying drawings, wherein like or similar reference numerals refer to the same or similar elements or elements having the same or similar function throughout. The embodiments described below with reference to fig. 1-6 are exemplary and intended to be used to illustrate the present application and should not be construed as limiting the present application.

In the description of the present application, it is to be understood that the terms "length," "width," "upper," "lower," "front," "rear," "left," "right," "vertical," "horizontal," "top," "bottom," "inner," "outer," and the like, as used herein, refer to an orientation or positional relationship indicated in the drawings, which is for convenience and simplicity of description, and does not indicate or imply that the referenced device or element must have a particular orientation, be constructed and operated in a particular orientation, and thus, is not to be considered as limiting.

Furthermore, the terms "first", "second" and "first" are used for descriptive purposes only and are not to be construed as indicating or implying relative importance or implicitly indicating the number of technical features indicated. Thus, a feature defined as "first" or "second" may explicitly or implicitly include one or more of that feature. In the description of the present application, "a plurality" means two or more unless specifically limited otherwise.

In this application, unless expressly stated or limited otherwise, the terms "mounted," "connected," "secured," and the like are to be construed broadly and can include, for example, fixed connections, removable connections, or integral parts; can be mechanically or electrically connected; either directly or indirectly through intervening media, either internally or in any other relationship. The specific meaning of the above terms in the present application can be understood by those of ordinary skill in the art as appropriate.

As shown in fig. 1 to 3, an embodiment of the present application provides a lithium ion battery 10, which includes a casing 11, a battery cell 12 disposed in the casing 11, and a cover plate device 20. The cover plate device 20 includes a substrate 21, a negative electrode assembly 30, a positive electrode assembly 40, and a sealing assembly 50, where the substrate 21 is disposed above the battery cell 12, the positive electrode assembly 40 is disposed on the substrate 21, and the substrate 21 is provided with an electrode through hole 22.

Specifically, the negative electrode assembly 30 includes a negative electrode post 31, the lower end of the negative electrode post 31 passes through the electrode through hole 22 and is fixed below the substrate 21, the sealing assembly 50 includes a first metal ring 51, a metalized ceramic ring 52 and a metal cover 53, the first metal ring 51 is welded to the upper side hole edge of the electrode through hole 22, so that the first metal ring 51 is directly welded to the upper end face of the substrate 21, and the upper end face of the substrate 21 does not need to be provided with a boss structure for the first metal ring 51, so as to simplify the manufacturing process of the substrate 21. The metallized ceramic ring 52 is hermetically arranged on the first metal ring 51, and the metal sealing cover 53 is covered on the metallized ceramic ring 52, so that the inner wall of the metallized ceramic ring 52, the inner wall of the first metal ring 51 and the metal sealing cover 53 enclose a sealed space, and the part of the negative pole 31 extending out of the electrode through hole 22 is accommodated in the sealed space.

The lithium ion battery 10 provided in the embodiments of the present application is further described below: in the lithium ion battery 10 provided in the embodiment of the present application, the first metal ring 51 of the sealing assembly 50 is welded to the upper hole edge of the electrode through hole 22, the metalized ceramic ring 52 is hermetically disposed on the first metal ring 51, and the metal cover 53 is disposed on the metalized ceramic ring 52 in a covering manner, so that the inner wall of the metalized ceramic ring 52, the inner wall of the first metal ring 51, and the metal cover 53 surround and form a sealed space above the substrate 21, and the part of the negative electrode pillar 31 extending out of the electrode through hole 22 is accommodated in the sealed space and connected to the metal cover 53, so that the sealing treatment of the negative electrode pillar 31 is achieved through the simple combination of the metalized ceramic ring 52, the first metal ring 51, and the metal cover 53, so that the structural design complexity of the sealing assembly 50 is simplified on one hand, and the metalized ceramic ring 52, the first metal ring 51, and the metal cover 53 disposed above the substrate 21 on the other hand, The first metal ring 51 and the metal sealing cover 53 do not occupy the assembly space of the battery cell 12 below the substrate 21, and further provide more assembly space for the battery cell 12, thereby facilitating improvement of the overall performance of the lithium ion battery 10.

In other embodiments of the present application, as shown in fig. 4 and 5, the seal assembly 50 further includes a second metal ring 54, the second metal ring 54 being sealingly connected between the metallized ceramic ring 52 and the metal cap 53. Specifically, by providing the second metal ring 54 between the metallized ceramic ring 52 and the metal cap 53, the overall strength of the seal assembly 50 is enhanced and a transition connection between the metallized ceramic ring 52 and the metal cap 53 is achieved.

In other embodiments of the present application, the upper end surface of the negative post 31 and the upper end surface of the second metal ring 54 are both welded to the lower cover surface of the metal cover 53. Specifically, by laser welding the upper end surface of the negative electrode tab 31 and the upper end surface of the second metal ring 54 to the lower end surface of the metal cover 53, the firmness of the metal cover 53 is improved, and the firmness of the assembly of the negative electrode tab 31 in the cover device 20 is also improved. Meanwhile, the metal cap 53 is additionally arranged at the upper end of the negative pole 31, so that the short circuit caused by the accidental contact of the negative pole 31 with the shell 11 can be avoided.

In other embodiments of the present application, as shown in fig. 4 and 5, the metalized ceramic ring 52 has a metal layer 55 formed on both the upper end surface and the lower end surface, and the upper end surface of the first metal ring 51 and the lower end surface of the second metal ring 54 are welded to the metal layers 55, respectively.

Specifically, the upper end surface of the first metal ring 51 and the lower end surface of the second metal ring 54 are welded to the two metal layers 55, respectively. The presence of the two metal layers 55 thus eliminates the residual stress present between the first metal ring 51 and the second metal ring 54.

Optionally, the first metal ring 51 and the second metal ring 54 are respectively welded to the corresponding metal layer 55 by laser welding, so that the existence of a brazing filler metal layer is avoided, the structure of the sealing assembly 50 is simpler and more reliable, meanwhile, the cover plate device 20 can be manufactured by welding without an injection molding process, so that an injection mold is saved, the degree of automation of manufacturing the cover plate device 20 is improved, the manufacturing cost of the cover plate device 20 is reduced, and the overall reliability of the lithium ion battery 10 is improved.

In other embodiments of the present application, the metal layer 55 is a nickel metal layer, a molybdenum metal layer, or a manganese metal layer. Specifically, by providing the metal layer 55 as a nickel metal layer, a molybdenum metal layer, or a manganese metal layer. Therefore, the metal layer 55 has good oxidation resistance and high temperature resistance, the mechanical property stability of the metal layer 55 is further ensured, and the connection strength of the metallized ceramic ring 52, the first metal ring 51 and the second metal ring 54 under the impact action of high temperature environment and external force is improved.

Alternatively, the metal layer 55 may be a single layer or a double layer, and when the metal layer 55 is a single layer, a nickel metal layer 55 is preferable, and when the metal layer 55 is a double layer or a multilayer, it is preferable to be composed of a molybdenum metal layer 55 and a manganese metal layer 55.

Optionally, the thickness of the first metal ring 51 is 0.2mm to 2mm, and the first metal ring 51 is an aluminum metal ring, so that the strength of the first metal ring 51 can be ensured while the weight of the first metal ring is reduced, and the overall strength of the sealing assembly 50 is further improved.

Similarly, the metalized ceramic ring 5243 has a thickness of 3mm to 10mm, and the difference between the inner diameter and the outer diameter of the ring is 2mm to 10 mm. The thickness of the second metal ring 54 is 0.2mm to 2mm, and the second metal ring 54 is an aluminum metal ring. This may further increase the overall strength of the seal assembly 5040.

Optionally, the metal layer 55 has a thickness of 20 μm to 200 μm. The inner diameter of the metal layer 55 is smaller than the inner diameter of the metallized ceramic ring 52, and the difference between the two is 1mm to 6 mm. This allows metal layer 55 to avoid contact with negative post 31 and short circuits.

In other embodiments of the present application, as shown in fig. 3, the negative electrode assembly 30 further includes a negative electrode adhesive layer 32, the negative electrode adhesive layer 32 is disposed on the lower end surface of the substrate 21, and specifically, is connected to the lower end surface of the substrate 21 by pressure welding, a cavity is formed on the lower end surface of the negative electrode adhesive layer 32, the negative electrode assembly 30 further includes a metal sheet 33, the lower end of the negative electrode pillar 31 is disposed on the metal sheet 33, the metal sheet 33 is embedded in the cavity, and a through hole 34 for the negative electrode pillar 31 to pass through is formed on an inner top surface of the cavity.

Specifically, by providing the negative electrode adhesive layer 32, the negative electrode adhesive layer 32 can perform a sealing function, and on the other hand, by forming the cavity, the negative electrode adhesive layer 32 can also perform a function of accommodating and protecting the metal sheet 33. This further improves the sealing performance of the cover device 20 and the reliability of the seal assembly 50.

In other embodiments of the present application, as shown in fig. 3, the positive electrode assembly 40 includes a positive electrode pillar 41, a positive electrode adhesive layer 42 and a positive electrode base 43, the positive electrode pillar 41 is welded on the upper end surface of the substrate 21, the positive electrode adhesive layer 42 is disposed on the lower end surface of the substrate 21, and is specifically connected to the lower end surface of the substrate 21 by pressure welding, the positive electrode adhesive layer 42 is provided with an installation through cavity 44, and the positive electrode base 43 is disposed in the installation through cavity 44 and is connected to the lower end surface of the substrate 21 by laser welding. Wherein, the positive post is aluminium utmost point post, and the base plate is aluminium base board, has so just realized the material selection uniformity of base plate and positive post to the reliability of positive post welded fastening in base plate has been promoted.

Specifically, the positive post 41 is directly welded to the upper end surface of the substrate 21, so that on one hand, the substrate 21 does not need to be perforated at a position corresponding to the positive post 41, thereby further improving the sealing performance of the cover plate device 20, and only one electrode through hole 22 needs to be formed in the substrate 21, thereby reducing the complexity of the manufacturing process of the substrate 21. On the other hand, the potential of the substrate 21, the potential of the battery case 11, and the potential of the positive electrode are made the same, so that the battery case 11, particularly the aluminum case 11, is protected from electrochemical corrosion.

The installation through cavity 44 is formed in the positive electrode glue layer 42, so that the positive electrode base 43 can be accommodated in the installation through cavity 44, the assembly space in the battery is saved and optimized, more redundant space is reserved for assembling the battery cell 12, the positive electrode glue layer 42 can wrap the positive electrode base 43, and the buffer protection of the positive electrode base 43 is realized.

In other embodiments of the present application, as shown in fig. 2 and 3, the substrate 21 is provided with a liquid injection through hole 23. Specifically, the liquid injection through hole 23 is formed in the substrate 21, so that the electrolyte can be injected after the substrate 21 is assembled, the difficulty of the battery manufacturing process can be simplified, and the complexity of the battery manufacturing process can be reduced.

In other embodiments of the present application, as shown in fig. 3, the base plate 21 is provided with an explosion-proof through hole 24, the cover plate device 20 further includes an explosion-proof sheet 25, an outer edge of the explosion-proof sheet 25 is welded to a hole edge of the explosion-proof through hole 24, specifically, welded to the hole edge of the explosion-proof through hole 24 by laser, and the explosion-proof sheet 25 is covered with an explosion-proof film 26.

Specifically, through setting up explosion-proof piece 25, when electric core 12 internal pressure was too big like this, can burst explosion-proof piece 25 and realize the battery pressure release, can avoid so that electric core 12 is inside because of the high temperature high pressure effect is on fire. By providing the rupture disk 26 on the rupture disk 25, the rupture disk 25 can be effectively prevented from splashing when the rupture disk is broken.

In other embodiments of the present application, as shown in fig. 2, 3 and 6, the explosion-proof plate 25 is formed with a plurality of guide grooves 27 which converge from the edge of the explosion-proof plate 25 to the center of the explosion-proof plate 25. Specifically, the presence of the guide groove 27 can guide the rupture of the rupture disk 25 to start along the center thereof, thereby realizing effective control of the rupture degree of the rupture disk 25 and avoiding the cell 12 from exploding due to short-time contact with excessive oxygen.

The present invention is not intended to be limited to the particular embodiments shown and described, but is to be accorded the widest scope consistent with the principles and novel features herein disclosed.
